questions.q: What are the three steps the Data Import Wizard walks you through?
options: Login, Export, Confirm
Choose data, edit mapping, start import
Install, Configure, Schedule
Select object, write SOQL, run query
questions.explain: After the prep work, the wizard itself is choose data, edit mapping, and start import.

questions.q: A CSV column is flagged "Unmapped" in the Edit Field Mapping screen. What happens if you start the import without fixing it?
options: The wizard automatically creates a new custom field for it
The import is blocked entirely until every column is mapped
Rows depending on that field can fail, since the data has nowhere to go
The column is silently renamed to match the closest Salesforce field
questions.explain: An unmapped column means that data isn't going anywhere — if it's required, those rows fail. The review screen's unmapped-field count is the signal to catch this before starting.

questions.q: After you click Start Import, where do you track the job's progress?
options: The same screen updates live with a progress bar
You must stay on the confirmation dialog until it finishes
The Bulk Data Load Job page, since the import runs asynchronously
An email arrives immediately with the final result
questions.explain: Start Import queues an asynchronous job. The confirmation dialog points you to the Bulk Data Load Job page to watch status and download results.

questions.q: Which of these is a real limit of the Data Import Wizard?
options: It cannot import Leads
It supports a fixed list of objects and caps at 50,000 records per job
It requires a paid add-on to run more than once
It can only be used in Salesforce Classic
questions.explain: The wizard supports a specific set of objects (Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Solutions, Campaign Members, person accounts, custom objects) and caps each job at 50,000 records.

questions.q: A job needs to load 80,000 Contacts using a custom matching rule for duplicates. Why does this fall outside the wizard?
options: Both the record count and the matching requirement exceed what the wizard supports
Contacts cannot be imported through the wizard at all
The wizard only accepts matching rules for Leads
80,000 records is within the limit, but custom matching requires Data Loader regardless of volume
questions.explain: 80,000 exceeds the wizard's 50,000-record cap, and the wizard's duplicate prevention is limited to account name/site or contact/lead email — not a custom matching rule. Either reason alone would be enough; together they're a clear signal to use Data Loader.
